changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 2a, item 8 (R24/R25): agents[].config.turn_timeout_ms and .approval_policy are no longer read - Codex approval policy is always 'never' (issue #2 trust model), and turn_timeout_ms was accepted-and-ignored with no runtime effect. Both keys are still tolerated (and ignored) in an existing config.json - a file that sets either does not need editing.
